title: Utility loss on path A: manual recovery on generators
summary: Utility undervoltage on the 27.5 kV feed of path A. ANSI 27 trips 52-U, the 13.8 kV bus is dead and UPS bank A carries the IT load on battery. The transfer controller and the sets are in REMOTE for this drill (no automatic transfer): start the generator bus and close 52-GM before the battery runs out. Switching the procedure does not call for counts as a violation.

steps.text: Acknowledge the path A alarms in the alarm banner
Start the generator bus (MV transfer A: Start generator bus)
Wait until the synchronised sets cover the path demand
Close 52-GM (MV transfer A: Transfer to generators)
